rationale: TopKGate.wg gets rebound to a fresh fp32 Linear inside forward, orphaning the ZeRO-tracked parameter. Detection requires checking that wg.weight.data_ptr stays constant across forwards AND that wg.weight remains in DeepSpeed's tracked parameter set. Layer schema_topo_precond: precond guard is 'TopKGate module + ZeRO stage>=1 + fp16/bf16 mixed precision' (rebind only triggers under that combo). Pattern P4 because detection reads module attr (the bound submodule's weight tensor) at runtime hook, not a static class check. Tier 6 needs named_parameters set membership. Borderline P4 vs P7: P4 chosen because the check is on identity/membership of a parameter object, not a counter/flag.
